title: Izwi Elaphonsela Inselele Ukubusa Kwesithombe
intro: Phakathi kwezithunywa zikaSomandla kwakukhona inceku eqotho eyavuka phakathi kwesizwe esilukhuni ukuze ilethe iqiniso. Abantu babo base bethathe unkulunkulu oqanjiwe, befulathela uMdali wakho konke okukhona. Ngesinqumo esiqinile, lo muntu wababiza ukuba babuyele emuva - kodwa umyalezo wahlangatshezwa ukwenqatshwa nokwenqatshwa. Ngena ezinkombeni ukuze uthole ukuthi ubani le nceku ezinikele.
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesithunywa kubantu abanenkani ababephambuke kude nendlela eqondile.
Ngize ukuzokhumbuza isizwe sami ngaLowo owadala konke okukhona — umdali omuhle kunabo bonke.
Abantu bami babephendukele esithombeni samanga ababesihlonipha futhi besibiza imini nobusuku.
Ngabaphonsela inselelo ngesibindi, ngibabuza ukuthi kungani bezokhulekela unkulunkulu oqanjiwe bese beshiya iNkosi yabo yeqiniso.
Bangiphikile, benqaba ukulalela, futhi babambelela emangeni abo — kodwa iNkosi yami yangilondoloza.
Ngingu-Ilyas — futhi ukuthula kwanikwa phezu kwami, futhi ngabalwa phakathi kwezinceku ezikholwayo zoMuntu Onomusa.
